topPRs.title: fix(tasks): bump eth/081, eth/082 and eth/087 Safe nonce pins by one
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
Fixes the scheduled `stacked_simulation_eth` failure on `main` ([CircleCI job 218119](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/218119)):

```
StateOverrideManager: User-defined nonce (78) is less than current actual nonce (79) for contract: 0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92 in task config file: .../eth/081-op-mainnet-set-batcher/config.toml
```

All three Safes used by these draft tasks are now one nonce ahead of the pins on mainnet (checked with `cast call ... "nonce()(uint256)"`): FoundationUpgradeSafe 79, L1PAO 48, SecurityCouncil 75.

| Task | Change |
|---|---|
| eth/081 | FUS 78 → 79 |
| eth/082 | L1PAO 47 → 48, FUS 79 → 80, SC 74 → 75 |
| eth/087 | FUS 83 → 84 (keeps the existing offset from 081) |

`VALIDATION.md` updates: message hashes, safe tx hashes, the eth/082 root L1PAO hash and its `approvedHashes` keys, pre-execution nonce comments, and nonce before/after state diffs. Calldata and domain hashes are unchanged.

I recomputed the hashes with `cast` (Safe EIP-712 struct hash with Multicall3, delegatecall, and `aggregate3Value(approveHash)` for the nested child approvals). Before using the method, I checked that it reproduces every old hash and key at the old nonces. I did not run `just simulate-stack` locally, so this CI run is the end-to-end check.

Prompted by: @mds1
